limitations: Browser UI not exercised; native server draft WebSocket API only.

Lutri, the Spellchaser did not appear in this seat's packs (A2 not-run); the probe used another pool card as the companion designation target. The protocol path - not the specific card - is what the issue reports missing.
Sealed used instead of pick-and-pass: the bug lives in the kind-independent Build Deck/SubmitDeck path.
Verdict is scoped to v0.114.0; this re-validation does not claim the bug is fixed or unfixed in any other build.
result: Deckbuilding view carries no 'companion' key (no companion control advertised); SubmitDeck with an extra 'companions' field is accepted as DraftStateUpdate but the field is silently discarded - no companion designation is stored or visible post-probe; plain SubmitDeck accepted (control). Same failure shape as the v0.83.0 and v0.111.0 runs.
scope: Sealed iko event (6 packs/seat, 8 seats) driven to Deckbuilding over WS protocol 153; Deckbuilding DraftPlayerView + DraftAction::SubmitDeck probed for a companion designation path; engine DeckList companion slot verified in the v0.114.0 source (crates/engine/src/game/deck_loading.rs, PlayerDeckList.companion line 75).
title: No way to add/set Companion in Build Deck after Draft
